disposition_reason: Prints lead, cadmium, nickel, copper and arsenic by both ICP-AES and AAS for cereals, breads, legumes, rice, canned tuna, processed meats and soft drinks bought in Amman, Jordan.

study.design: market survey with method comparison (ICP-AES vs AAS) on single retail samples
study.origin: rice by country as labelled (USA, India, Bangladesh, China, Thailand, Iraq, Sri Lanka); other origins not stated
study.method: ICP-AES (Shimadzu ICPE-9820) and flame AAS (GF-AAS for arsenic) after hot-plate HNO3 (cereals, rice), HNO3/H2SO4 (meat, tuna) or HNO3 evaporation (soft drinks, 25 mL to 50 mL) digestion
study.qa: calibration linearity only (r2 table); no CRM, recovery or blanks reported
